description: This file defines styles and class behaviors for a carousel component, including layout, transitions, controls, indicators, and themes in a SASS/SCSS format.
external_files: variables and mixins referenced via @include (e.g., clearfix(), transition(), color-mode())

classes.name: .carousel
classes.description: Main container for the carousel component, managing position and interaction.

classes.name: .carousel-item
classes.description: Represents individual slides within the carousel, including active, next, and previous states.

classes.name: .carousel-control-prev
classes.description: Navigation control to move to the previous slide.

classes.name: .carousel-control-next
classes.description: Navigation control to move to the next slide.

classes.name: .carousel-indicators
classes.description: Container for slide indicator controls (e.g., dots).

classes.name: .carousel-fade
classes.description: Modifier class providing fade transition effects for carousel slides.

classes.name: .carousel-dark
classes.description: Theme variant for dark mode styling of the carousel.

methods.name: clearfix()
methods.description: Mixin to clear floats and contain children elements.

methods.name: transition()
methods.description: Mixin to apply CSS transitions, parameterized by transition properties.

methods.name: color-mode()
methods.description: Mixin to switch themes or color modes, such as dark mode.

methods.name: escape-svg()
methods.description: Function to escape SVG code for safe inline usage in CSS backgrounds.
